value.rationale: The motivating sampled Mellin calculus raises Schatten refinements of multiplicativity defects. The simplest nontrivial canonical defect already known only to be trace class has a distinct sharp quasi-Banach ideal phase transition at p=1/2, with a two-sided explicit norm bracket and a transparent lattice-cancellation structure. The complete cutoff in 0<p<1 is a natural operator invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a trace recomputation; no general semigroup classification is claimed.
